title: Tirzepatide versus Semaglutide Once Weekly in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes
journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

key_findings.claim: Dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonism achieved superior dose-dependent glycemic control and body weight reduction compared to selective GLP-1 agonism alone
key_findings.citation_location: Frías et al., N Engl J Med 2021;385:503-515, Table 2
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Multi-pathway incretin therapy provides personalized options for patients with severe insulin resistance under clinical supervision.

key_findings.claim: Adverse events were primarily mild-to-moderate gastrointestinal symptoms that attenuated with gradual clinical dose titration
key_findings.citation_location: N Engl J Med 2021;385:503-515, Safety Analysis
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Reinforces why Steer employs careful doctor-guided titration rather than unmonitored self-administration.
